scope: 51 new documented resources; existing MemProcFS, PyLingual, boofuzz and Keystone descriptions and execution evidence are preserved
evidence_boundary: Primary-source/document walkthroughs; no execution verification is claimed for these 51 records. Existing execution examples remain separately scoped.
license_boundary: API values are metadata, not a complete audit of bundled code, samples, codecs or hardware licenses.

records.name: Corkami PoCs
records.description: Minimal and unusual executable and document samples for studying file-format edge cases and parser behavior.
records.task_and_output: Minimal and unusual executable and document samples for studying file-format edge cases and parser behavior
records.constraints: Read selected PE/PDF examples and compare their byte layout with the documented format; no samples were executed. Licensing must be checked per upstream file.

records.name: Hextree
records.description: Hands-on mobile and hardware reverse-engineering courses and interactive labs; **Commercial**, with some free content.
records.task_and_output: Hands-on mobile and hardware reverse-engineering courses and interactive labs
records.constraints: Official page separates free signup/material from a paid subscription. No paid course or hardware lab was completed.

records.name: Malware Analysis Training
records.description: Windows malware-analysis course with programming, Windows-internals, and reversing exercises; labs need a suitable Windows analysis environment.
records.task_and_output: Windows malware-analysis course with programming, Windows-internals, and reversing exercises
records.constraints: The course links CC BY 4.0 while its badge mentions 3.0; this review does not resolve that discrepancy or grant rights to sample binaries.

records.name: Malware Unicorn RE101
records.description: Introductory Windows malware-reversing workshop covering x86 assembly, triage, and debugging; its VM-based lab instructions use older software images.
records.task_and_output: Introductory Windows malware-reversing workshop covering x86 assembly, triage, and debugging
records.constraints: The official lab lists 8 GB RAM and 40 GB storage and a Windows 10 VM image updated in 2019; no supplied malware/VM image was executed.

records.name: Reverse Engineering by Kevin Thomas
records.description: Annotated assembly and reverse-engineering lessons across x86, x64, ARM, AVR, and RISC-V, with lesson-specific toolchain and hardware requirements.
records.task_and_output: Annotated assembly and reverse-engineering lessons across x86, x64, ARM, AVR, and RISC-V, with lesson-specific toolchain and hardware requirements
records.constraints: Annotated assembly and reverse-engineering lessons across x86, x64, ARM, AVR, and RISC-V, with lesson-specific toolchain and hardware requirements.

records.name: REDasm
records.description: Native disassembler and analysis GUI with legacy-format support; Windows and Linux are the primary tested hosts, while other platform builds have lower support tiers.
records.task_and_output: Native disassembler and analysis GUI with legacy-format support
records.constraints: The reviewed source identifies Windows/Linux as actively tested; macOS/FreeBSD are CI-tested without manual GUI validation and Haiku is compile-only.

records.name: rev.ng
records.description: LLVM- and QEMU-based binary-analysis framework and decompiler for inspecting and transforming native code; source builds need its documented toolchain.
records.task_and_output: LLVM- and QEMU-based binary-analysis framework and decompiler for inspecting and transforming native code
records.constraints: Whole project is GPLv2 due to components including QEMU, while individual files have MIT terms; source and binary packaging are distinct.

records.name: bpftrace
records.description: Linux eBPF tracing language for observing kernel and user-space functions; available probes and permissions depend on the host kernel.
records.task_and_output: Linux eBPF tracing language for observing kernel and user-space functions
records.constraints: available probes and permissions depend on the host kernel.

records.name: r2frida
records.description: radare2 plugin for Frida-backed process inspection and instrumentation; requires a compatible radare2 build and a working Frida session with the target.
records.task_and_output: radare2 plugin for Frida-backed process inspection and instrumentation
records.constraints: README lists radare2, compiler/build utilities and Node/npm for source compilation. Host-side frida-tools is not itself a mandatory dependency.

records.name: System Informer
records.description: Windows 10+ process and system inspector for handles, memory, services, and related kernel information; some views require elevated access.
records.task_and_output: Windows 10+ process and system inspector for handles, memory, services, and related kernel information
records.constraints: some views require elevated access.

records.name: TinyTracer
records.description: Intel Pin tool for tracing execution and selected function or API calls; use the documented platform build and a matching Pin kit.
records.task_and_output: Intel Pin tool for tracing execution and selected function or API calls
records.constraints: README links separate Windows and Linux build instructions. No assumption that every trace/API feature works identically on both.

records.name: uftrace
records.description: Linux function-call tracer for C/C++, Rust, and Python, with call graphs and timing data; native-code coverage depends on instrumentation or supported dynamic tracing.
records.task_and_output: Linux function-call tracer for C/C++, Rust, and Python, with call graphs and timing data
records.constraints: native-code coverage depends on instrumentation or supported dynamic tracing.

records.name: Al-Khaser
records.description: Windows proof-of-concept suite for exercising anti-debugging, anti-VM, anti-hooking, and other analysis-environment checks.
records.task_and_output: Windows proof-of-concept suite for exercising anti-debugging, anti-VM, anti-hooking, and other analysis-environment checks
records.constraints: Windows proof-of-concept suite for exercising anti-debugging, anti-VM, anti-hooking, and other analysis-environment checks.

records.name: HollowsHunter
records.description: Windows process scanner using PE-sieve to find and dump injected or modified code across running processes; findings require manual investigation.
records.task_and_output: Windows process scanner using PE-sieve to find and dump injected or modified code across running processes
records.constraints: findings require manual investigation.

records.name: Scylla
records.description: Windows x86/x64 import-table reconstruction tool for dumped PE files; upstream documents older Windows versions, so current-host compatibility needs checking.
records.task_and_output: Windows x86/x64 import-table reconstruction tool for dumped PE files
records.constraints: Source/default-branch snapshot is from 2019 and the published 0.9.8 release from 2015. This is a legacy tool, not evidence of validation on current Windows.

records.name: ScyllaHide
records.description: Windows x86/x64 user-mode anti-anti-debugging library with x64dbg, OllyDbg, and IDA integrations; debugger and plugin versions must match.
records.task_and_output: Windows x86/x64 user-mode anti-anti-debugging library with x64dbg, OllyDbg, and IDA integrations
records.constraints: This is user-mode hiding, not a kernel anti-debug solution. Do not infer a GDB plugin from generic debugger language.

records.name: Didier Stevens Suite
records.description: Python utilities for inspecting PDF, OLE, scripts, and other suspicious document inputs; dependencies and input support vary by script.
records.task_and_output: Python utilities for inspecting PDF, OLE, scripts, and other suspicious document inputs
records.constraints: No root README was available. The reviewed oledump.py header declares public-domain source; dependencies, terms and behavior of every other script were not audited.

records.name: Dumpulator
records.description: Emulates selected user-mode code from Windows minidumps for tasks such as string decryption and unpacking; dump completeness and supported execution context limit what can run.
records.task_and_output: Emulates selected user-mode code from Windows minidumps for tasks such as string decryption and unpacking
records.constraints: The implementation has explicit WOW64 handling; the earlier blanket x64-only review comment is not adopted. No real minidump was executed.

records.name: FakeNet-NG
records.description: Intercepts traffic and emulates network services for dynamic analysis; supports Windows and selected Linux modes, with platform-specific setup and traffic-redirection privileges.
records.task_and_output: Intercepts traffic and emulates network services for dynamic analysis
records.constraints: supports Windows and selected Linux modes, with platform-specific setup and traffic-redirection privileges.

records.name: CFR
records.description: Java class and JAR decompiler for inspecting managed code; requires a Java runtime, and language-feature compatibility varies by input and release.
records.task_and_output: Java class and JAR decompiler for inspecting managed code
records.constraints: README distinguishes running a released JAR from Maven/source-build prerequisites. No decompilation correctness is inferred solely from version support.

records.name: Medusa
records.description: Frida-based modular mobile runtime-analysis framework; documented hosts are Linux and macOS, with limited Windows functionality and target-side instrumentation prerequisites.
records.task_and_output: Frida-based modular mobile runtime-analysis framework
records.constraints: documented hosts are Linux and macOS, with limited Windows functionality and target-side instrumentation prerequisites.

records.name: LLDB scripts by Derek Selander
records.description: LLDB commands, aliases, and Python helpers for Apple-platform investigations; individual scripts have architecture and debugger-version limits.
records.task_and_output: LLDB commands, aliases, and Python helpers for Apple-platform investigations
records.constraints: For example, the enhanced disassembly command is documented as terminal/x86-64-specific. Loading the entire collection is not evidence every command supports ARM64.

records.name: Heimdall
records.description: EVM bytecode-analysis toolkit for disassembly, decompilation, and contract inspection; inferred source, types, and signatures require validation.
records.task_and_output: EVM bytecode-analysis toolkit for disassembly, decompilation, and contract inspection
records.constraints: inferred source, types, and signatures require validation.

records.name: r2flutter
records.description: radare2 plugin and CLI for recovering Dart AOT snapshot metadata from Flutter binaries; requires radare2 6.2.2+, primarily targets AArch64, and depends on snapshot layout.
records.task_and_output: radare2 plugin and CLI for recovering Dart AOT snapshot metadata from Flutter binaries
records.constraints: The support document distinguishes source layout profiles and structural guesses from actual regression coverage. It describes Android and iOS containers; do not restrict it to Android solely on an older review comment.

records.name: Redress
records.description: Recovers compiler metadata, packages, types, and symbols from stripped Go executables; target Go-version compatibility depends on the selected release and GoRE parser.
records.task_and_output: Recovers compiler metadata, packages, types, and symbols from stripped Go executables
records.constraints: The default branch and latest release are different evidence channels. Latest release v1.2.98 was published 2026-10-20; no unsupported mothballed classification is used.

records.name: reFlutter
records.description: Flutter mobile-analysis framework that instruments matching engine builds and produces method or type information; Android/iOS architecture and engine-version support varies.
records.task_and_output: Flutter mobile-analysis framework that instruments matching engine builds and produces method or type information
records.constraints: The current source documents Android arm64/arm32/x64 and iOS arm64 with engine/version constraints. That is documentation, not execution of each target.

records.name: WhatsABI
records.description: TypeScript library for inferring Ethereum ABI entries and resolving proxy metadata from bytecode; inferred signatures and types are not original-source recovery.
records.task_and_output: TypeScript library for inferring Ethereum ABI entries and resolving proxy metadata from bytecode
records.constraints: inferred signatures and types are not original-source recovery.

records.name: Netzob
records.description: Python protocol-inference library for exploring fields, messages, and state models from captures; installation needs native dependencies and the documented Python environment.
records.task_and_output: Python protocol-inference library for exploring fields, messages, and state models from captures
records.constraints: README documents Python 3.8+ plus native libpcap/libffi/build dependencies. Old packaged examples are not proof of compatibility with every newer Python.

records.name: avatar2
records.description: Coordinates debuggers, emulators, and physical targets for embedded analysis; each endpoint needs its own compatible backend and any associated hardware.
records.task_and_output: Coordinates debuggers, emulators, and physical targets for embedded analysis
records.constraints: each endpoint needs its own compatible backend and any associated hardware.

records.name: ChipWhisperer
records.description: Hardware and Python tooling for side-channel power analysis and fault-injection experiments; live capture and glitching require compatible capture and target hardware.
records.task_and_output: Hardware and Python tooling for side-channel power analysis and fault-injection experiments
records.constraints: Capture board, target board, firmware and trace-analysis software are separate components; software/source availability does not supply hardware.

records.name: esptool
records.description: Serial bootloader utility for reading or flashing Espressif devices, with offline `image-info` inspection of firmware headers, segments, checksums, and SHA-256 hashes; requires Python 3.10+, and 5.6.0 returns exit code 0 for checksum/hash mismatches.
records.task_and_output: Serial bootloader utility for reading or flashing Espressif devices and inspecting firmware images offline
records.constraints: Current source requires Python 3.10+; reading and flashing need a compatible device connection; offline `image-info` is exercised by the resource-intake examples, and no device was connected.

records.name: FACT
records.description: Linux firmware extraction, analysis, and comparison platform; the native installer has specific distribution and Python requirements, while the separate Docker route is unmaintained.
records.task_and_output: Linux firmware extraction, analysis, and comparison platform
records.constraints: Reviewed installer lists Debian 13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04/26.04; Python 3.10–3.14, at least four cores/eight GB RAM and additional result storage. The separate Docker image is explicitly unmaintained.

records.name: HALucinator
records.description: Firmware-rehosting framework that replaces selected hardware-abstraction-layer calls with models; requires its emulation toolchain and target-specific handlers or configuration.
records.task_and_output: Firmware-rehosting framework that replaces selected hardware-abstraction-layer calls with models
records.constraints: Review covers the documented rehosting approach and setup only, not ready-to-run emulation of arbitrary firmware or physical peripherals.

records.name: Proxmark3
records.description: RFID and NFC research client and firmware for compatible Proxmark3 hardware; client, firmware, and device variants need to match.
records.task_and_output: RFID and NFC research client and firmware for compatible Proxmark3 hardware
records.constraints: client, firmware, and device variants need to match.

records.name: ripcord
records.description: Ghidra-based firmware-analysis pipeline producing queryable Parquet tables for DuckDB; requires Ghidra 11.2+ with PyGhidra and Python 3.11+, with optional simulation tooling.
records.task_and_output: Ghidra-based firmware-analysis pipeline producing queryable Parquet tables for DuckDB
records.constraints: Ghidra/PyGhidra, Python, uv, Snakemake and DuckDB setup are documented; Renode/cross-toolchains are optional for simulation/test-corpus paths.

records.name: Hex Fiend
records.description: macOS hex editor for inspecting and editing large binary files, with binary templates and an embeddable framework.
records.task_and_output: macOS hex editor for inspecting and editing large binary files, with binary templates and an embeddable framework
records.constraints: macOS hex editor for inspecting and editing large binary files, with binary templates and an embeddable framework.

records.name: FModel
records.description: Windows x64 GUI for inspecting and extracting Unreal Engine game archives and assets; title-specific mappings, versions, or encryption keys may be needed.
records.task_and_output: Windows x64 GUI for inspecting and extracting Unreal Engine game archives and assets
records.constraints: The reviewed project file targets net10.0-windows, uses WPF and win-x64. That source-build requirement is separate from published release packaging.

records.name: ReClass.NET
records.description: Interactive process-memory structure editor for Windows and Linux; upstream documents Linux support tested on Ubuntu 18.04, rather than current-distribution validation.
records.task_and_output: Interactive process-memory structure editor for Windows and Linux
records.constraints: Linux/Mono support is explicit in upstream documentation; the historical Ubuntu 18.04 evidence must not become either a Windows-only claim or a current Linux guarantee.

records.name: Source 2 Viewer
records.description: Parser, decompiler, exporter, and Windows viewer for Valve Source 2 resources and VPK archives; format coverage and export fidelity vary by resource type.
records.task_and_output: Parser, decompiler, exporter, and Windows viewer for Valve Source 2 resources and VPK archives
records.constraints: The official current download site lists Windows 11 and OpenGL 4.6 for the viewer. Source README says some formats are incomplete and export may lose data.

records.name: UModel
records.description: Unreal Engine package viewer and asset exporter for Windows and Linux; game/version compatibility varies, and the official site leaves licensing undetermined.
records.task_and_output: Unreal Engine package viewer and asset exporter for Windows and Linux
records.constraints: Official page lists Windows/Linux and notes no Linux GUI. Its displayed update/release dates and licensing note are historical, so they are recorded rather than treated as new compatibility tests.

records.name: vgmstream
records.description: Library and command-line tools for decoding proprietary game-audio streams; supported formats, codec dependencies, and player integrations vary.
records.task_and_output: Library and command-line tools for decoding proprietary game-audio streams
records.constraints: API license metadata is incomplete; upstream component/codec licensing applies. No decoder or codec matrix was executed.

records.name: Binlex
records.description: Binary-feature analysis framework with CLI and language bindings for similarity and corpus investigation; build and plugin dependencies vary by interface.
records.task_and_output: Binary-feature analysis framework with CLI and language bindings for similarity and corpus investigation
records.constraints: build and plugin dependencies vary by interface.

records.name: BINSEC
records.description: Binary-analysis platform combining symbolic execution, abstract interpretation, and SMT solving; source builds require OCaml and compatible solver/backend dependencies.
records.task_and_output: Binary-analysis platform combining symbolic execution, abstract interpretation, and SMT solving
records.constraints: source builds require OCaml and compatible solver/backend dependencies.

records.name: flare-emu
records.description: Archived Unicorn-based emulation helper for IDA Pro, Rizin, and radare2 scripting; analysis-host APIs and Python bindings must match the archived source.
records.task_and_output: Archived Unicorn-based emulation helper for IDA Pro, Rizin, and radare2 scripting
records.constraints: Repository archived state is true. README documents IDA, Rizin and radare2 integrations, not Ghidra.

records.name: KLEE
records.description: LLVM-bitcode symbolic-execution engine for generating test inputs and finding assertion violations; requires a compatible compiler/runtime setup and does not imply proof from an incomplete run.
records.task_and_output: LLVM-bitcode symbolic-execution engine for generating test inputs and finding assertion violations
records.constraints: Finding no failing assertion during a bounded symbolic-execution run is not a proof over every feasible path.

records.name: PANDA
records.description: QEMU-based whole-system record/replay and analysis framework with taint-analysis plugins; analysis depends on supported guest architectures, recordings, and matching plugins.
records.task_and_output: QEMU-based whole-system record/replay and analysis framework with taint-analysis plugins
records.constraints: analysis depends on supported guest architectures, recordings, and matching plugins.

records.name: S2E
records.description: Selective symbolic-execution platform for analyzing programs across OS boundaries; requires a supported Linux host, the S2E toolchain, and prepared guest images.
records.task_and_output: Selective symbolic-execution platform for analyzing programs across OS boundaries
records.constraints: Official s2e-env guide documents supported 64-bit Debian/Ubuntu hosts, substantial builds and guest-image preparation; no VM stack was built for this review.

records.name: Z3
records.description: SMT solver with command-line and language APIs for expressing and solving analysis constraints, such as recovering inputs that pass a decompiled check; in the Python API `>>` on bit-vectors is an arithmetic shift (C's unsigned `>>` is `LShR`), and a solver can return unknown.
records.task_and_output: SMT solver with command-line and language APIs for expressing and solving analysis constraints
records.constraints: Satisfiability results depend on the model and solver outcome, including possible unknown results; the Python bit-vector API (z3-solver 5.3.1.0) is exercised by the resource-intake examples.

records.name: BAP
records.description: Binary-analysis platform for lifting native code into an intermediate language and running analyses; source installation uses OCaml/opam and a compatible LLVM toolchain.
records.task_and_output: Binary-analysis platform for lifting native code into an intermediate language and running analyses
records.constraints: source installation uses OCaml/opam and a compatible LLVM toolchain.

records.name: Remill
records.description: Library for lifting supported machine instructions into LLVM bitcode; requires compatible LLVM and build dependencies, with Windows support documented as experimental.
records.task_and_output: Library for lifting supported machine instructions into LLVM bitcode
records.constraints: README documents LLVM 15+, CMake 3.21+, Linux/macOS and experimental Windows; lifting instructions is not equivalent to recovering a whole program.

records.name: Zydis
records.description: x86/x86-64 instruction decoding and encoding library for building analysis tools; source builds use CMake or the documented Visual Studio project.
records.task_and_output: x86/x86-64 instruction decoding and encoding library for building analysis tools
records.constraints: source builds use CMake or the documented Visual Studio project.
